section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the evolution of body image research, focusing on the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its revised version, BAS-2. It reviews previous psychometric validations of BAS-2 in various cultural contexts and identifies limitations, such as the lack of research in adolescent populations and invariant character across weight status. The aim of the current study, referred to as 'this study', is to examine the psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in Brazilian adolescents, including factorial validity, internal consistency, temporal stability, and correlations with life satisfaction, social physique anxiety, and BMI.
